name: Moryskah Diary
summary: Bog, blood, and barrows. Vampyres roam the canopy and ghasts pull travellers off the path. Bring silver, holy water, and a strong stomach.

tasks.description: Enter Moryskah from the Heartlands.
Kill a ghast.
Buy holy water from Apothecary Nira.
Enter the slayer tower.
Kill a crawling hand in the tower.
Talk to Father Dorin.
Pick up ectoplasm from a ghast.
Kill 5 ghasts without leaving the swamp.
Buy a silver sickle.
Bury bones in Moryskah.
Drink from every apothecary potion (Father Dorin's round).
Complete 1 easy clue step in Moryskah.
Chop a cursed oak tree in the swamp.
Enter the Canifis wolfsbane garden (exploration).
Craft a silver dagger on the Moryskah anvil.

easy.reward: Moryskah cape (easy) + emote: drink from flask. Diary lamp (easy).
easy.perk_description: Moryskah teleport (3/day); holy water refill at any Moryskah altar.

tasks.description: Complete The Bog Witch's Bargain.
Kill a banshee with a proper nosepeg equipped.
Pickpocket a vampyre juvenile.
Kill an aberrant spectre in the slayer tower.
Collect a vial of blood from a vampyre.
Use a silver sickle against a vampyre (bonus damage).
Kill a werewolf with melee.
Navigate to the Bog Witch without dying to ghasts.
Collect 5 wolfbane herbs.
Enter the Moryskah slayer tower upper floor.
Complete 5 Guardians of the Rift minigame rounds.
Pickpocket a vampyre juvenile 3 consecutive times without failing.
Complete 1 medium clue step in Moryskah.
Farm a kwuarm herb in the Moryskah patch.
Use the Moryskah swamp tram between villages.

medium.reward: Moryskah cape (medium) + slayer tower shortcut. Diary lamp (medium).
medium.perk_description: Slayer tower shortcut between floors; +10% ectoplasm drops; silver sickle special attack regen +50%.

tasks.description: Complete the Blood Rites quest.
Kill a vyrewatch.
Complete one Barrows run (kill all 6 brothers).
Kill a bloodveld in the catacombs.
Get a Barrows equipment piece from the chest.
Kill a gargoyle (slayer 75).
Kill a nechryael (slayer 80).
Navigate Castle Malachar without dying.
Forge a silver stake at the Sootworks using Moryskah materials.
Collect all 3 Malachar unique drops.
Craft a silver-tipped holy sickle using Moryskah materials.
Complete 3 hard clue steps in Moryskah.
Mix 20 super attack potions at the Moryskah apothecary.
Participate in the Temple Trekking minigame (Moryskah route).
Discover the hidden moss-shrouded chapel (exploration).

hard.reward: Moryskah cape (hard) + Barrows teleport, free Barrows equipment repair. Diary lamp (hard).
hard.perk_description: Barrows teleport unlocked; +5% rare drop chance from Barrows; free repair at Bob's anvil.

tasks.description: Defeat Count Malachar solo.
Kill 200 vampyres in Moryskah.
Complete every Moryskah quest.
Kill an abyssal demon in the catacombs (slayer 85).
Craft blood runes at the blood altar.
Kill Cerberus (slayer 91).
Complete the Barrows collection log.
Use Blood Barrage on a vampyre stack.
Kill a dark beast (slayer 90).
Complete an elite clue step in Castle Malachar.
Perform a 4-brother Barrows speed-run under 3 minutes.
Reach 99 in Runecrafting training primarily on blood runes.
Complete the Moryskah Fight Arena speedrun (under 7 minutes).
Harvest 100 grimy snapdragon herbs.
Discover the abandoned Morytania lighthouse cellar (exploration).

elite.reward: Moryskah cape (elite — bloodveiled recolour), blood altar teleport, Moryskah apothecary bank teleport (M9 fix — previously missing), vampyric arm-bracer (cosmetic). Diary lamp (elite). Chance at Vyreling pet (1/5000 per Count Malachar kill after completion).
elite.perk_description: Blood altar teleport; Moryskah apothecary bank teleport (fills bank-teleport gap flagged in diary-audit.md §3); +10% blood rune output; auto-loot Barrows brothers chest fee waived; Vyreling pet eligibility.
